items.title: Gajigo Urges Upper River Region Voters to Back Bensouda, Reject Ruling Party
items.summary: By Fatou Sillah Dr. Ousman Gajigo, a member of Coalition 2026, urged residents of the Upper River Region to support Talib Ahmed Bensouda, saying the ruling National People’s Party had no claim to their allegiance and should not take their votes for granted. Speaking at a coali...
